palette: steel blue lease hall, lapis filing rails, moss tenancy ribbons, brick void stamps, bone paper, slate ink
typography: lease headings on steel rail tabs, bone chips with lapis and brick seals
composition: a lease hall where form rules gate six-month contracts, three indefinite entries drain into one pool, the one-house podium ranks three tenants by possession filing and seniority, and the sublease switchboard routes a six-month rescission window into consent
surface: bone paper dossiers, steel desk rails, lapis filing stamps
motion: lease chips hop the written-form gate, three entries converge into the indefinite pool, tenant chips climb the podium in statutory order while losers keep valid claims, and the sublease token passes a six-month gate that either opens rescission or flips to consent
transition: the steel hall floor, lapis rails and brick stamp posts persist while gates, pools, podiums and switchboards are re-dressed between scenes
